answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A basalt registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the yarrow penalty lands on the stake. A terrace tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 11886 identities cost 2523 paid peers, 164643 tokens of stake and 54911 dollars. Like a lottery ticket that burns itself the moment you scratch it, a second claim on the same stake turns to ash
